text:
maria.docs: Quick thread- I pushed a small patch to the function-calling examples to handle missing optional keys and to show a tolerant parse path. Can someone sanity-check?

jeremy_doc: link? Ill glance. small nit: prefer 'envelope' naming for the wrapper example, we already use that in other guides.

maria.docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210 (draft) changes: added 'tolerant parsing' subsection, compact envelope example, and updated TS/py snippets to SDK v1.8.

sam_eng: skimmed. +1 for envelope naming. Suggest example show both strict JSON schema flow and fallback that preserves raw output for debugging. keep it < 20 lines.

yuki_ml: also add a one-liner about optional fields: "When schema marks a field as nullable, accept missing or null; prefer defaulting in post-process." People hit parse errors otherwise.

alice-sdk: I updated the TS snippet in the branch to the new invoke signature. Small helper added: ```ts
function parseOrRaw(text: string) {
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { return { _raw: text }; }
}
```

jeremy_doc: nice. can you also include a tiny python equivalent (3 lines) so readers on docs page see parity?

alice-sdk: will add py snippet next commit.

link-checker-bot: Found 1 broken anchor in PR 4210: /guides/structured-output#old-envelope -> 404.

maria.docs: thanks bot I renamed anchor to #envelope-pattern and fixed internal refs.

sam_eng: one more thought: add a short guardrail box: "If parser fails, log raw model output and send to offline eval. Do not auto-rely on best-effort parse without human review for critical flows." Keep it single sentence.

yuki_ml: also mention token-budget impact for big structured fields  recommend truncation or summary fields before emitting to model.

maria.docs: added TODOs for those two bullets. Plan: alice pushes py snippet, I fix the guardrail copy and run link checker again. Will tag reviewers after.

alice-sdk: pushed python snippet and small fix.

link-checker-bot: Recheck complete  no broken links found.

maria.docs: perfect. tagging @leigh and @thom for final review before merge. thanks team! :shipit:
